description: SRAM read timing from dV = I*t/C: bit-line capacitance, signal needed, and how long before a 1 can be told from a 0. The signal needed is the amplifier sensitivity PLUS several sigmas of its offset, which usually dominates. Also returns the time for 1/2/4/8 banks. First-order: constant cell current, capacitance linear in cell count, no line resistance or column coupling. The reads-per-second figure is signal development only — a real read adds precharge, decoding and amplification.

banks.description: How many banks the column is split into

cellCurrentUa.description: Current with which the cell discharges the line

cellsPerColumn.description: Cells hanging off each bit line: this sets the capacitance

sensitivityMv.description: Smallest difference the amplifier resolves nominally

sigmas.description: Sigmas of offset demanded as margin

name: sram_read_path
